activity.notes: Ali Dinar restored the Darfur sultanate after the Mahdist collapse in 1898 and remained its last sultan until he was killed on 6 November 1916 during the Anglo-Egyptian conquest. The 1898-1916 reign is standard in specialist Darfur scholarship.

sources.title: Between an Anvil and a Hammer — The Reign of Ali Dinar, 1898–1916
sources.citation_text: Cambridge's Darfur history explicitly titles the period as the reign of Ali Dinar, 1898-1916.

sources.title: Ali Dinar: Last Sultan of Darfur, 1898-1916
sources.citation_text: The standard monograph identifies Ali Dinar as the last Sultan of Darfur for 1898-1916.

sources.title: Ali Dinar
sources.citation_text: The biographical chronology gives Ali Dinar's restored reign from September 1898 to his death on 6 November 1916.
